Subject: Orion Health — architectural immersion: schedule & agenda

Hi Samir / Anya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical session with our ML/infra team:

Recap (brief):
- Primary goal: validate feasibility of serving Orion Health models at low latency while meeting HIPAA-like controls and regional residency.
- Main risks: long-tail latency on peak loads, model quantization impacts on accuracy, and audit logging requirements.

Proposed session (please pick one):
- Option A: Wed 23 Jun, 09:00–10:30 PT (90m)
- Option B: Thu 24 Jun, 11:00–12:00 PT (60m) — tighter, focused runbook
- Option C: Mon 28 Jun, 14:00–15:30 PT (90m)

Suggested agenda (flexible):
1) 10m — goals & success criteria (you)
2) 25m — architecture walkthrough: network, VPC/private control plane, data flow
3) 20m — runtime details: batching, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs, kernel selection
4) 20m — reliability & compliance: audit logs, KMS/HSM integration, retention
5) 10–15m — Q&A and immediate next actions

Attendees we recommend from Redwood: Connor O'Brien (runtime lead), Grace O'Connor (solutions / compliance). Please confirm the Orion attendees (we usually need an infra/ops engineer and an ML owner).

I attached a short agenda PDF and a precall checklist (what we'd like you to have ready). If there are specific compliance artifacts you want referenced (SOC 2 report, data residency statement), tell us up front and we'll bring the right docs.

If any of the proposed windows work, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short pre-read.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear agenda. Option B (Thu 24 Jun, 11:00–12:00 PT) works best for our team.

Attendees from Orion:
- Samir Khan (CTO)
- Anya Petrov (Head of ML)
- Jordan Lee (Infra Engineer) — will own network/security questions

A couple quick asks:
- Please include a brief SOC 2 / security evidence slide or pointer (we'll start procurement).
- Data residency: we operate primarily out of EU regions; we need to confirm whether Redwood can pin model serving to eu-west zones for production.
- Would like the session recorded (for internal stakeholders) and slides shared afterward.

If you can send a calendar invite with the Zoom link, we'll accept. Looking forward to a pragmatic run-through.

—Samir
